# PPC Per-Team Drop
# category: PPC
# type: DynamicAttachment

Input/output spec:

Input:  n (1 <= n <= 1e6), then n integers up to 1e9.
Output: count of distinct subarrays whose XOR is a power of 2.
Constraint: 1-second wall time on the judge.
Sample input: 5\n1 2 3 4 5\nSample output: 6

# expected flag pattern: FINDIT{dynamicattachment_ppc_[team-specific]}
